physical_subject: Can deliberately flipped answers still estimate a group proportion?
relationship: Binary randomized response retaining truth with probability3/4 yields expected yes fraction1/4+p/2, invertible for an unbiased aggregate estimate, with sampling error and limited privacy.
operation: Four equally likely cards show truth-dependent response probabilities; expected counts separate signal and noise; an all-no group still produces some yes reports.
closest_prior: Earlier false-alarm Bayes example, noisy prediction and secret-sharing titles
substantive_difference: This explains deliberate response randomization and aggregate debiasing; it does not infer an individual condition or reconstruct a shared secret.
